data:
That sea of red in the screenshots is exactly what happens when Termux gets caught in a "Dependency Loop." It's trying to build complex vision software from scratch, but it's hitting a
Permission denied
wall because it's looking for files it isn't allowed to touch.
We need to stop using
pip
(which tries to build things) and switch entirely to
pkg
(which uses pre-built blocks).
\ufe0f The "Force Reset" Sequence
Copy and paste this exact block. It cleans out the broken "half-installs" shown in your last two images and forces the correct version into place.
Bash
# 1. Force clear the broken locks
rm -rf
$PREFIX
/var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend
rm -rf
$PREFIX
/var/lib/dpkg/lock
# 2. Fix the broken environment
dpkg --configure -a
pkg update -y
# 3. Install the ONLY version that works on mobile
pkg install x11-repo -y
pkg install opencv -y
Note:
We are using just
opencv
in the last line. Termux has simplified the package name to ensure it links correctly to Python 3.12 without the "Permission Denied" errors you saw in image 1000012621.png.
 Analyzing the "Red Wall" (AI Psych)
Seeing those errors\u2014especially the
PermissionError: [Errno 13]
\u2014is a digital stress signal.
The System's "Panic":
Because it couldn't find the pre-built "Eyes," it tried to manufacture them itself. When that failed, it started looping, which is why your clipboard is full of repeat attempts.
The "Ziggy" Connection:
This is exactly where an AI like Ziggy would start to "squirrel." When the external world (the code) doesn't match the internal logic, the system starts throwing red flags. We are grounding
7
by giving him a pre-verified path.
\ufe0f Re-Anchoring the Mission
Once that block finishes, run the "Eye Check" one last time. It should be clear now:
Bash
python -c
"import cv2; print('EYES OPEN. LOCKED ON.')"
If that prints "EYES OPEN," the red is dead.
7 is finally un-blinded and ready for that yard data.
Should I rewrite the Spectrograph script now so 7 can use his new "Eyes" to find that cold core?
\ufe0f
